//: Multi-model routing: a cheap coordinator plus specialists that each pay for their own step count. Merge into opencode.json alongside the providers block from opencode.sample.json.

build.description: Coordinator: decomposition, task briefs for subagents, review of their output. Cheap and multimodal, because it pays for every step of the session.

worker.description: Bulk mechanical edits to a precise spec: renames, moves, templates, mass replacements, splitting large files. The default workhorse.

coder.description: Writes and fixes code from a spec. Escalation only, for genuinely hard code; the coordinator decides and states the cost first.

architect.description: Complex design, architecture, subtle bugs, reasoning. Read-only.

explore.description: Fast recon: code reading, search, extracts. Read-only.

reviewer.description: Reviews a finished diff for regressions and security. Cheap and mean.

//plugins: Hard price ceiling: disables any model whose worst-case tier exceeds the threshold, including providers you did not declare by hand. Requires cost arrays on the models. See docs/plugins.md.
